# SportsVentureX (SVX)

> Buyer-focused B2B OEM/ODM contract manufacturing, product development, global sourcing, and critical-path delivery partner.

SportsVentureX (SVX) is a contract sports goods manufacturer and global sourcing specialist headquartered with commercial operations in London, United Kingdom, coordinating vetted production facilities globally. SVX specializes strictly in three core product categories: **Custom Technical Socks**, **Match & Training Footballs**, and **Technical Sports Bags**.

## Main Pages

- [Home](https://www.sportsventurex.com/): Company overview, manufacturing network, 12-stage digital supply chain, brand experience, and commercial inquiry brief.
- [Socks Manufacturing](https://www.sportsventurex.com/products/socks): 22 specialist sock development categories (performance, grip, compression, merino wool, organic cotton, cycling, and lifestyle).
- [Footballs Manufacturing](https://www.sportsventurex.com/products/footballs): 8 match, training, and specialist football construction categories (thermo-bonded, hybrid, hand-stitched, futsal).
- [Bags Manufacturing](https://www.sportsventurex.com/products/bags): 13 technical sports carry solutions (waterproof Oxford backpacks, boot bags, team duffles, wheelie travel luggage).
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.sportsventurex.com/privacy-policy): UK GDPR-compliant data governance for B2B commercial briefs and tech packs.

## Core Manufacturing Programmes

### 1. Custom Sports & Technical Socks OEM/ODM
- **Knitting Technology**: 96N, 144N, 168N, and 200N single/double cylinder jacquard knitting machines.
- **Yarn Capabilities**: Combed organic cotton (GOTS-certified), CoolMax polyester, merino wool, recycled nylon (GRS-certified), elastane, and conductive/antimicrobial yarns.
- **Technical Features**: Hand-linked seamless toe closures, arch compression bands, graduated calf compression (15-20 mmHg / 20-30 mmHg), silicone micro-grip pads, and blister-prevention terry loop cushioning.
- **Packaging**: Retail-ready branded header cards, hangtags, multi-pack banding, barcode labels, and FSC-certified polybags.

### 2. Match & Training Footballs OEM/ODM
- **Construction Standards**: Thermo-bonded seamless panels (zero water absorption), hybrid machine-stitched with sealed seams, and traditional 32-panel hand-stitched match builds.
- **Performance Levels**: Engineered to meet FIFA Basic, FIFA Quality, and FIFA Quality Pro aerodynamic, sphericity, bounce, and pressure retention standards.
- **Materials**: Textured PU/TPU outer shells (1.0mm-1.5mm), high-density EVA foam backing (3.5mm-5.0mm), multi-ply polyester/cotton laminated layers, and reinforced Taiwan butyl or synthetic latex bladders.
- **Use Cases**: Professional match balls, academy training balls, indoor/futsal balls (low rebound), beach footballs, and promotional event ranges.

### 3. Technical Sports Bags & Backpacks OEM/ODM
- **Fabrics & Materials**: Heavy-duty 600D, 900D, and 1680D ballistic Oxford polyester with PU/PVC water-resistant backings; ripstop nylon; lightweight TPU tarpaulin.
- **Hardware & Components**: Branded SBS/YKK waterproof zippers, ergonomic air-mesh shoulder harnesses, padded laptop/tablet sleeves, wet/dry shoe compartments with brass ventilation eyelets, and reinforced webbing.
- **Categories**: Player club backpacks, team kit holdalls, technical gym duffles, waterproof transition triathlon packs, boot bags, and tournament luggage.

## Factory Compliance & International Standards

Production facilities in the SVX global network operate under rigorous international labor, ethical, and environmental accreditations:
- **BSCI (Business Social Compliance Initiative)** / **Sedex SMETA 4-Pillar Audited**
- **ISO 9001:2015** (Quality Management Systems)
- **OEKO-TEX Standard 100** (Harmful substance-free textile safety)
- **GRS (Global Recycled Standard)** for recycled yarn programmes

## Commercial Process & Inquiries

1. **Define**: Category, customer target, technical specifications, MOQ, target unit price, and required delivery date.
2. **Develop**: Tech pack generation, material selection, rapid physical prototyping (sampling within 7-14 days).
3. **Validate**: Fit, laboratory bounce/wear testing, compliance certification, and pre-production sample signoff.
4. **Produce**: Factory line allocation, inline quality checks (AQL 2.5 standard), and weekly digital supply chain milestone visibility.
5. **Deliver**: Pre-shipment inspection, export documentation, customs clearance, and DDP/FOB logistics coordination.
